notes.title: Demo Update!
notes.content:
Hey Ya'll:

We fixed a few minor bugs:
	- Saw in Job is a Job level
	- Clipping Ball & Chain in Shaky Legs level
	- Added more jets in Drones Etc level
	- Volumetric Glow setting should save properly

Thanks so much for playing our demo. The full early-access release is slated for the summer of 2024. We really appreciate any feedback on the technical and game play aspects of the game as we’re still in the alpha stage of development.  Please don't hesitate to post any issues in the discussions section.

- R & K
